name: Automation flow sketcher
why: Lays out a repeat task as a Zapier or Make automation with what can break, a quick start before the full build spec.

name: Repeat chore automation planner
why: Sorts the team's weekly chores into those worth handing to a tool, like the automation candidates prompt.

name: Hidden value check
why: Finds what a step quietly does before you cut or automate it, so the automation does not drop it.

name: Process waste finder
why: Marks each process step as value or waste, so pointless steps are removed before automating.

name: Check a new automation before relying on it
why: Finds double runs and missing approvals and gives a test checklist, matching the review and fix skill.

name: Build an n8n automation that reports failures and is reusable
why: An n8n build with failures that show and retry, a worked example of loud failure handling.

name: Make a recurring process easier to hand over
why: Writes a procedure and exception guide, useful for the handover note after go-live.

name: Process change note writer
why: Tells the team what changes and from when once an automation replaces a manual step.

name: Email automation gaps and trigger reviewer
why: Reviews email flows and triggers for gaps and rule conflicts, a close cousin of the automation review.

name: Data file clean-up loop
why: Cleans a messy file and saves the rules, handy before importing old spreadsheets into Airtable or Notion.
